subject: SapphireCloud private offer — MAP, evaluation plan & billing path
messages:
From: Elena Vogt <elena.vogt@sapphirecloud.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: SapphireCloud Procurement <procurement@sapphirecloud.io>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Private offer / MAP for SapphireCloud (AWS)

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement asked me to follow up and capture a concise mutual action plan for the AWS private offer — specifically: evaluation cadence, acceptance criteria, billing path (AWS Private Offer vs invoice), and procurement lead times.

High-level constraints from our side:
- POC window needs to start as early as possible (we're looking at a 2–3 week technical evaluation).
- Finance prefers a PO-based flow but we can consider committing via private offer if it shortens provisioning.
- Security will request SOC2 artifacts and a short data flow doc.

Can you send a one-page MAP and a recommended close timeline (targeting production in mid-November if feasible)? Also please include any template PO and the acceptance checklist you use for marketplace offers.

Appreciate it — copying our procurement lead Ravi (ravi.m@sapphirecloud.io) so he has visibility.

Best,
Elena
Elena Vogt
Head of Cloud Programs
SapphireCloud

--
attachments: none
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Vogt <elena.vogt@sapphirecloud.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer / MAP for SapphireCloud (AWS)

Elena — great to connect. Thanks for the clear ask.

Attached is a first-draft MAP (SapphireCloud_MAP_v1.xlsx) that lays out:
- 2-week evaluation plan with explicit checkpoints (Week 1 smoke tests, Week 2 acceptance run)
- Acceptance criteria (functional tests + latency and token-cost sampling)
- Proposed billing path: AWS Private Offer for initial provisioning, then invoice settlement via PO to Redwood Finance (Net30)
- Procurement milestones and responsible owners (Procurement, Sales Ops, Legal)

Proposed timeline (high level):
- 10/22: Finalize MAP & technical access
- 10/25–11/05: 2-week evaluation window (canary traffic + acceptance run)
- 11/06–11/10: Legal/PO routing & billing setup
- 11/15: Target production cutover (subject to acceptance)

I'll attach SOC2 snapshot and a PO template in my next note for your team. Can we schedule a 30-min call tomorrow 10/22 to run through the checkpoints and confirm finance requirements? Kimberly and Grace are on copy to help with billing and success plan.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Enterprise GTM — Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

--
attachments: SapphireCloud_MAP_v1.xlsx
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: SapphireCloud MAP — finance & billing gate

Marcus / Grace —

Reviewing the MAP draft: a couple operational items we need to lock before we send the MAP as final to SapphireCloud procurement:
1) Billing route: if we push AWS Private Offer we need the PO to reference the private offer ID. Finance will want to know whether SapphireCloud expects AWS to issue invoices (marketplace) or Redwood to invoice directly.
2) Payment terms: confirm if SapphireCloud requires Net30 or Net45 (I noted Elena mentioned PO preference).
3) Currency: check whether billing must be EUR for EU legal entity or USD (impacts tax).
4) Legal: please ask Tessa for any required standard addenda for marketplace flows (we may need a short SOW or acceptance appendix).

I've attached a lightweight PO template (PO-template-sapphire.docx) we can supply to the customer's procurement team to speed legal/finance review. I'll ping Finance with the deal id RWI-4829 once we confirm currency/terms.

Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
--
attachments: PO-template-sapphire.docx
From: Elena Vogt <elena.vogt@sapphirecloud.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ravi Menon <ravi.m@sapphirecloud.io>, SapphireCloud Procurement <procurement@sapphirecloud.io>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 14:22:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Private offer / MAP for SapphireCloud (AWS)

Thanks Marcus — this looks useful. Quick clarifications from our procurement/security: 
- Can the acceptance criteria include a latency SLA check at 95th percentile under a small canary (SapphireCloud will provide synthetic load)? We need that to validate performance before routing traffic.
- For billing: preference is still PO invoicing (SapphireCloud AP will take a PO referencing Redwood). If AWS Private Offer accelerates provisioning, we can sign that as long as billing ultimately routes to our AP (via a customer invoice or an AWS invoice that our AP can accept).
- Currency: we'll be USD for this contract.

Ravi (copied) is our procurement owner and will coordinate PO issuance timelines. Our target: confirm PO by 11/05 so we can meet a 11/15 production date.

Elena

Subject: Final MAP v1 & next steps (SapphireCloud)

Elena / Ravi —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and clarity. I've attached two files: SapphireCloud_MAP_v1.xlsx (finalized with the added latency SLA checkpoint) and SOC2-snapshot-2026.pdf for your security team. Key points agreed and next actions below: 

Agreed checkpoints (summarized):
- 10/29: MAP v1 sent to procurement (this email)
- 10/30–11/05: Provisioning & evaluation access; SapphireCloud runs canary and synthetic tests (we will provide a short load script)
- 11/06–11/10: Acceptance run and PO routing to Redwood Finance (please reference deal RWI-4829 on the PO)
- 11/15: Target production cutover if acceptance passes

Action items:
- SapphireCloud (Ravi): confirm PO issuance date and preferred billing contact (AP email) — requested by 11/05.
- SapphireCloud (Elena): run 95th-percentile latency test in the canary and send results in-thread.
- Redwood (Kimberly): once PO details are confirmed, Kimberly will open the invoice route and confirm whether the private offer ID should be included in the PO.
- Redwood (Tessa): I'll loop in legal immediately if any acceptance appendix is needed.

If we get the PO by 11/05 we are on track for the 11/15 production target. If procurement needs more time we can plan a short staging window and a rolling cutover.

Thanks — attaching the files now.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
